extracted.name: Quick & Easy Pizza Dip
extracted.description: Pepperoni pizza dip is everything you love about pizza toppings in dip form: melty cheese, flavorful sauce, and crispy pepperoni. Bake till hot and bubbly, then scoop it up with crostini, breadsticks, or fresh veggies. Ready in just 35 minutes, this appetizer is quick and easy to make, and even quicker to disappear.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces (226g) brick cream cheese, softened to room temperature
3/4 cup (180g) sour cream or plain Greek yogurt
optional for garnish: fresh parsley and/or basil
instruction_lines: Using a handheld or stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the cream cheese, sour cream/yogurt, garlic powder, dried basil, and dried oregano together in a medium bowl until smooth and creamy. Spread into the bottom of a 9-inch pie dish, cake pan, or similar size casserole dish that can hold 1.5–2 quarts.

Spread the pizza sauce over the cream cheese layer. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Top with pepperoni, then sprinkle with grated parmesan. Bake for 18–20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and garnish with fresh parsley and/or basil, if using. Serve hot with your favorite dippers, such as crostini, breadsticks, chips, raw veggies, pita wedges, etc.
Cover leftover pizza dip and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
